reason: The anther stalk is the filament.
'Stalk of anther' means the filament.
A sepal segment is normally a free sepal, or a lobe of a fused calyx. Calyx lobe is only right for the second meaning. Rejecting is safer.
Calyx segments are free sepals in some floras and fused lobes in others. Calyx lobe fits only the fused case.
Same as 'calyx segment'. The plural can mean free sepals as well as fused lobes.
A tepal lobe is a lobe of the perianth.
Plural of 'tepal lobe'.
A pit hair is a kind of hair, so trichome is right as the bearer.
Plural of 'pit hair'.
'Rootstock' is already a synonym of rhizome in PO. The same word can also mean a woody base or caudex, so the mapping is not perfect.
Spelling variant of 'root stock'.
These are the veins between the primary veins, so they are lamina veins. The more specific position is lost, but the bearer is right.
Plural of 'inter-primary vein'.
'Cyme-like' says the raceme looks like a cyme. Mapping to raceme drops that, and the term is doubtful.
Same as the singular. 'Cyme-like' is dropped.
An aculeus is a prickle.
Latin plural of aculeus.
'Bearing bulblets' is a verb phrase, not a part. The bearer is the plant or organ that carries the bulblets.
Bulblets are small bulbils. Some bulblets are underground offsets, so this is slightly loose.
A tooth on the margin of the leaf blade is a leaf lamina tooth.
The leaflet blade apex is the leaflet apex.
Alar cells sit in the basal angles of a moss leaf. 'Marginal basal cells' are the basal cells along the margin, which is a different group. No exact class exists.
Same as the singular. Marginal basal cells are not alar cells.
A perianth tooth is a small perianth lobe. In liverworts the teeth at the mouth are finer than lobes, so this is a little loose.
Plural of 'perianth tooth'.
A plantlet is a small whole plant, usually a vegetative propagule.
Plural of 'plantlet'.
An adventitious plantlet is a plantlet. The 'adventitious' part is lost, but the bearer is right.
A secondary stem is a branch. 'Secondary axis' is already a PO synonym of branch.
Plural of 'secondary stem'.
A simple cyme is a cyme. The 'simple' part is lost, but the bearer is right.
Plural of 'simple cyme'.
French for 'simple cymes'.
'With blades' is a prepositional phrase, not a part name. The bearer is the organ that has the blades.
'Acicular' is a shape (needle-like). Mapping the whole phrase to trichome drops it. The bearer should be hair and the quality acicular.
Same as the singular. The shape 'acicular' is lost.
'Adventitious root' is already a PO synonym of shoot-borne root.
'Adventitious root' is already a PO synonym of shoot-borne root.
French for adventitious roots.
An anther sac is a pollen sac. 'Anther lobe' is a synonym in PO.
Plural of 'anther sac'.
'Apice' is a variant spelling of apex, and plant organ apex covers it.
'Apices' is the plural of apex.
Basal veins are the veins that start at the base of the blade. Mapping to leaf lamina vein loses that position.
A bracteal leaf is a bract.
French for bracteal leaf.
Plural of 'bracteal leaf'.
A cauline sheath is the sheath of a stem leaf, which is a leaf sheath.
French for cauline sheaths.
Plural of 'cauline sheath'.
